title: Contextual Incident Quick Actions + Cost-Aware Escalation Flow
creator: Asha Mehta
description: Design a compact, contextual "quick actions" surface on incident/alert cards in the Console that: (1) surfaces the most appropriate remediation actions based on alert type and SLO signal, (2) shows estimated cost impact for escalation (e.g., enabling dedicated workers, temporary scale-up), and (3) includes single-click handoff links for the on-call engineer and postmortem starter templates. This ticket covers UI flows, microcopy, accessibility considerations, and a high-fidelity prototype for PM/Eng review.
acceptance_criteria: High-fidelity prototype (Figma) covering alert list + incident detail with quick actions annotated
Design tokens and spacing spec for compact action surface consistent with Console system
Content matrix mapping alert types to recommended actions and cost delta estimates
Annotated handoff links: call, slack-mention, create-postmortem (prefill), and add-to-rotation actions
Accessibility checklist passed (keyboard, focus, contrast) and UX review notes addressed
UX sign-off from PM and Engineering (Eng on-call infra lead)
assets: figma: Compact action surface frames (List, Detail, Modal)
copy: microcopy guide for action confirmations and tooltips
